w/c 23 Nov 2026 · Squat & Hinge & Push
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Recumbent bike
1 set5 minsRecumbent bikeBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Sit back in the seat with your back against the pad and slide the seat so your knee keeps a slight bend when the pedal is furthest away. Rest your hands on the side handles.

Movement: Pedal at the set pace or resistance for the set time, keeping a smooth, steady rhythm.

Focus: Keep your back resting on the pad and your knees tracking straight, not rolling in or out. Pedal smoothly, and build the time before you build the resistance.

Squat – single shoulder load
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit4kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a dumbbell or kettlebell resting on one shoulder, held in place by the same-side hand, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Squat down by sending the hips back and bending the knees to a comfortable depth, then drive up to stand tall. Complete the set, then switch the weight to the other shoulder.

Focus: Resist leaning or twisting towards the loaded side, keeping the shoulders and hips level and the chest up. Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, and work both sides.

Push press – DB
2 sets8-10 repsDB2 x 3kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the shoulders, palms facing in, feet hip-width, ribs down, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Dip slightly at the knees, then drive up through the legs to help press the dumbbells overhead, then lower under control.

Focus: Use a short controlled leg dip and drive, keeping the ribs down and not arching the back on the press. Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, press both dumbbells evenly, and control the lower to the shoulders.

Cross trainer
1 set5 minsCross trainerBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Single leg deadlift – supported
3 sets10 repsBodyweightBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other leg ready to travel back, standing knee soft, arms ready, with light fingertip support on a wall, chair back or rail beside you.

Movement: Hinge forward from the hip, letting the free leg travel back and the arms lower, then return to standing.

Focus: Hinge from the hip with a flat back, keeping the hips level and not opening out. Keep the standing knee soft, move slowly, and control the return. Use light fingertip support only - enough to steady you, not to hold you up. Take the hand away when you feel steady, not before.

Sit-up
3 sets10 repsMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands across the chest or lightly behind the head, ribs down.

Movement: Curl up from the floor one vertebra at a time until the torso is upright over the hips, then lower back down under control.

Focus: Curl rather than swing, keeping the neck neutral and the feet down without hooking them under anything. Lower slowly instead of dropping, and stop short of the range if the lower back complains.

Pad work
3 sets10 repsBoxing padsBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand in a balanced stance, hands up, knees soft, core engaged, facing the pads.

Movement: Strike the pads through the set combinations, returning the hands to guard each time, in rhythm.

Focus: Keep the movements controlled and the wrist firm on contact, not over-reaching or snapping the elbow. Stay balanced with soft knees, and keep the core engaged.

w/c 23 Nov 2026 · Hinge & Pull & Carry
Note any changes on the main lifts. Tap Show pictures or Show description on a move to see how it's done.
How to run it
One round: do each exercise once, in order, and you're done. Rest as you need between them.
Main Circuit
Good mornings – hugged
2 sets8-10 repsAny kit~5kg
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, knees soft, hugging a weight to your chest with both arms, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and hinge forward with a flat back until the hamstrings load, then drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: The weight sits high on the chest, so the back works hard to stay flat. Hinge at the hips, not the waist, and only go as far as that flat back allows.

Row – landmine, single arm
2 sets8-10 each sideBarbell/LandmineModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Straddle or stand beside a landmine bar, hinge with a flat back, one hand on the bar end, arm extended, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hip, driving the elbow back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hips still, leading with the elbow and squeezing the shoulder blade. Don't round or twist to lift, and control the lower.

Suitcase hold
2 sets30s each sideAny kitModerate
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall with your feet hip-width, holding a weight in one hand by your side, shoulders level and core braced.

Movement: Stand still and hold the weight for the set time without leaning, then change hands.

Focus: Stay tall with your shoulders and hips level, not leaning away from or towards the weight. Keep your ribs down and your grip firm, and breathe steadily.

Full can exercise
2 sets8-10 repsDBLight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Stand tall, arms down and slightly out in front at about 30 degrees, thumbs pointing up, a light weight in each hand, or none.

Movement: Raise the arms to shoulder height in that line with thumbs up, then lower under control.

Focus: Lead with the thumbs and keep the shoulders down, not shrugging, raising only to shoulder height. Use a light weight, and control the lower.

Side plank – feet stacked
2 sets30s each sideMatBodyweight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your side, forearm down with the elbow under the shoulder, legs straight and feet stacked.

Movement: Lift the hips so the body forms a straight line from head to heels and hold for the set time.

Focus: Keep the hips high and the body in one straight line, resisting the sag towards the floor. Keep the shoulder stacked over the elbow and the neck long, and stop when the line drops.

Supine hamstring stretch
2 sets20sTowel/BandLight
Did something different? Change Sets, Reps or Weight.

Start: Lie on your back, one leg extended, the other lifted towards the ceiling, hands or a strap behind the thigh.

Movement: Gently draw the lifted leg towards you, keeping it fairly straight, until you feel a hamstring stretch, then hold.

Focus: Draw the leg in only to a comfortable stretch, keeping a slight knee bend if needed. Keep the lower back relaxed on the floor, breathe, and don't force the range.

Suitcase squat
How to

Bench press – paused
How to
3 x 6-810kg

Start: Lie on the bench, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched back and down, grip a little wider than shoulders, unrack over the chest.

Focus: Hold the pause on the chest with the shoulder blades set and the elbows tucked, not flared. Keep the feet planted and the wrists stacked, and press up without bouncing off the pause.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the back from arching as each foot leaves the floor, and keep the hips level rather than dropping on the lifted side. Move slowly, with no bounce or swing between steps.

Deadlift
How to
2 x 8-1010kg

Start: Stand with the weight on the floor between your feet, feet hip to shoulder-width. Push the hips back and hinge to take hold of it with both hands, back flat, chest up, shoulders over the weight.

Movement: Drive through the floor and stand tall, pushing the hips forward and squeezing the glutes at the top. Hinge the hips back to lower the weight under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat from start to finish, never rounded. The power comes from the hips and legs, not the lower back or arms. Keep the weight close to your body on the way up and down.

Row – BB, bent-over
How to
3 x 1010kg

Movement: Pull the bar towards the lower chest or upper abdomen, driving the elbows back, then lower under control.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rising or rounding as you row, this protects the lower back. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and control the lower.

Focus: Stay tall and level as each foot leaves the floor, not leaning away from the weight or swaying side to side. Lift the knee slowly and place the foot down quietly.

Thread the needle – ViPR

Movement: Reach the ViPR low across the body, then sweep it up and across to the opposite side on a diagonal. Flow through the full pattern and repeat both ways.

Focus: Reach the ViPR down and across toward the floor outside one foot, then sweep it up and across on a diagonal, letting the spine move freely through its range. Keep the movement smooth and controlled end to end, matching depth to comfort.

Cycling / bike
How to
1 x 3 mins

Start: Set the saddle so the knee has a slight bend at the bottom of the pedal stroke, hands on the bars, torso relaxed.

Movement: Pedal at the set pace or resistance for the set time, keeping a smooth steady rhythm.

Focus: Keep the pedalling smooth and the knees tracking straight, not rolling in or out. Sit with a relaxed upright posture, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Goblet squat
How to
2 x 8-104kg

Start: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell close to your chest with both hands, elbows tucked down, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the weight at the chest and the torso upright, then drive up through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees in line with the middle toes, never caving in, and the heels flat. Keep the chest up and the weight close, and squat only as deep as you can control comfortably.

Romanian deadlift – staggered stance
How to
2 x 8-1010kg

Start: One foot flat, the other half a step back on its toes. Weight in front of the thighs, soft bend in the front knee.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front leg until the hamstring loads, then drive the hips forward to stand tall. Swap legs halfway.

Focus: Most of the weight sits on the front leg, the back foot is only there for balance. Back flat, hips square, not twisting open.

Cross trainer
How to
1 x 5 mins

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Chest press – cable
How to
3 x 102 x 7kg

Start: Stand at a chest-height cable, a handle in each hand at the chest, staggered stance, shoulder blades set, core braced.

Movement: Press the handles forward together until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the torso square and still, resisting the cable's pull to twist you. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the return.

Pallof press
How to
3 x 8 each side7kg

Start: Stand side-on to a cable or band at chest height, feet shoulder-width, hands holding the handle at the chest, core braced.

Movement: Press the handle straight out in front of you, resisting the pull that wants to rotate you, hold briefly, then draw it back.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square, letting nothing rotate you towards the cable, this is the whole exercise. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and press smoothly rather than snatching.

Pad work

3 x 10

Start: Stand in a balanced stance, hands up, knees soft, core engaged, facing the pads.

Movement: Strike the pads through the set combinations, returning the hands to guard each time, in rhythm.

Focus: Keep the movements controlled and the wrist firm on contact, not over-reaching or snapping the elbow. Stay balanced with soft knees, and keep the core engaged.

Logged by James
Pull-through – cable
How to
2 x 8-10~10kg

Start: Face away from a low cable, rope between your legs, feet shoulder-width. Step forward to take the tension, hands holding the rope, soft knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and let the rope draw between your legs with a flat back, then drive the hips forward to stand tall and squeeze the glutes.

Focus: Drive the movement from the hips, not the arms, the arms just hold the rope. Keep the back flat, and finish standing tall without leaning back or arching.

Seated cable row – close neutral grip
How to
3 x 10Moderate

Start: Sit at the low cable, feet braced, a neutral close handle, arms extended, chest up, back tall.

Movement: Pull the handle to the lower abdomen, elbows driving back close to the body, then return slowly under control.

Focus: Drive the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades, keeping the back tall and still. Keep the shoulders down, and control the return without rocking.

Farmer's carries
How to
3 x 20mModerate

Start: Stand tall holding a heavy weight in each hand at the sides, feet hip-width, ribs down, shoulders back.

Movement: Walk forward with controlled steps for the set distance, keeping the torso tall and steady.

Focus: Stand tall with the ribs down and shoulders back, not letting the weights pull you into a slump. Take steady steps, brace the core, and keep the weights from swinging.

Lat pulldown
How to
3 x 10~20kg

Start: Sit at the machine, thighs under the pads, hands on the bar wider than shoulders, arms extended up, chest up.

Movement: Pull the bar down towards the upper chest by driving the elbows down, then return it up slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbows and squeeze the shoulder blades down, not shrugging up. Keep the chest up and avoid leaning back to heave the bar, and control the return.

Ski erg
How to
5 minsBodyweight

Start: Stand tall holding the handles overhead, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Pull the handles down and back while hinging slightly at the hips, then return under control, repeating in rhythm.

Focus: Drive from the trunk and hips with a flat back, not rounding to pull. Keep the knees soft and the movement smooth, and build the pace gradually.

Glute bridge – bilateral
How to
3 x 10Light

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, close enough that your fingertips brush your heels.

Movement: Drive through your heels and push your hips towards the ceiling until knees, hips and shoulders form a straight line. Squeeze the glutes, hold two seconds, then lower slowly.

Focus: Lift with the glutes, not by arching the lower back. Keep the ribs down and the core braced. Stop at a straight line, don't push on into the back.

Swings – KB
How to
2 x 8-1010kg

Start: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor in front, feet hip-width, hinged with a flat back, core braced.

Movement: Hike the kettlebell back between the legs, then drive the hips forward to swing it up to about chest height, letting it swing back down into the next hinge.

Focus: Power the swing from a sharp hip drive, not the arms or lower back, keeping the back flat throughout. Snap the glutes at the top with the ribs down, and let the arms just guide the bell.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady, not rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the wrists straight.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor as the limbs extend, never letting it arch. Move slowly and controlled, and shorten the reach if the back lifts.

Box squat – weighted
How to
3 x 10-125kg

Start: Stand in front of a box at about knee height holding a light weight at the chest, feet hip to shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then stand tall through the heels, keeping the weight at the chest.

Cross trainer
How to
5 mins

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Romanian deadlift – BB
How to
3 x 8-1010kg

Start: Stand tall with a barbell held at the front of your thighs, hands just outside your legs, feet hip-width. Set the shoulders back, brace the core hard, and keep a soft bend in the knees.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the front of your legs, keeping it in contact, until you feel a strong stretch in the hamstrings. Keep the knees still and the shins vertical. Drive the hips forward to stand tall and finish with the glutes.

Focus: The back stays flat from start to finish, never rounded. This is a hip hinge, not a squat, so the movement happens at the hips while the bar tracks close to the legs. Only lower as far as you can hold a flat back, and don't lean back or over-arch at the top.

Row – landmine, single arm
How to
3 x 10-12 each side15kg bar

Start: Straddle or stand beside a landmine bar, hinge with a flat back, one hand on the bar end, arm extended, core braced.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hip, driving the elbow back, then lower under control.

Focus: Curl smoothly and control the return, keeping the thigh still and the hips level. Keep the movement pain-free, and match both legs across sets.

Balance board – double leg
How to
3 x 30sBodyweight

Start: Stand on a balance board with both feet, knees soft, torso tall, near a support.

Movement: Keep the board level and steady, making constant small adjustments, for the set time.

Focus: Keep the knees soft and the hips level, adjusting from the ankles to keep the board steady. Fix the eyes on a point, keep the core engaged, and keep support within reach.

Elbow plank – arm reach
How to
3 x 8 eachBodyweight

Start: Set up in a forearm plank, straight line from head to heels, core and glutes braced.

Movement: Keeping the hips level, reach one arm forward off the floor, hold briefly, return, then the other.

Focus: Keep the hips level and square as you reach, resisting any twist. Keep the ribs down and the core braced, and keep the reach controlled so the line stays straight.

Box squats – medium box
How to
3 x 8Bodyweight

Start: Stand in front of a box or chair at about knee height, feet hip to shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Push the hips back and sit down to lightly touch the box, then stand tall by driving through the heels. Control the descent throughout.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the chest up. Sit back onto the box under control rather than dropping, and drive up through the heels.

Hip thrust – DB
How to
3 x 10Moderate

Start: Sit with your upper back against a bench, a dumbbell held on its end across the front of your hips. Feet flat and hip-width, chin tucked, core braced.

Movement: Drive through the heels and push the hips up to a straight line from knees to shoulders, squeeze the glutes at the top, hold briefly, then lower with control.

Focus: Finish with the glutes at a straight line, don't over-arch the lower back. Keep the ribs down and the chin tucked so the work stays in the hips, and hold the dumbbell steady.

ISO split squat – bodyweight
How to
3 x 20s each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand in a split stance, one foot forward and one back, weight balanced, torso tall, hands at the chest.

Movement: Lower straight down until both knees are bent towards right angles and hold that bottom position still for the set time.

Focus: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, not caving in, and the torso upright through the hold. Keep the weight balanced between both legs, and hold only at a depth the knees tolerate.

Landmine press
How to
3 x 1020kg

Start: Hold the end of a landmine bar at one shoulder, standing tall or half kneeling, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the bar up and slightly forward along its arc until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and the core braced so the lower back doesn't arch. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and follow the bar's arc rather than forcing it straight up.

Single arm row – DB
How to
3 x 10 each sideModerate

Start: Hand and knee on a bench, the other foot planted, a dumbbell in the free hand hanging down, back flat and level.

Movement: Pull the dumbbell towards the hip, driving the elbow back and up, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, keeping the back flat and level, not twisting to lift. Keep the shoulder down, and control the lower.

Bird-dog – weighted arm
How to
3 x 8 each sideModerate

Start: On all fours, a light weight in one hand or a cuff on the wrist, back flat and neutral, core braced.

Movement: Reach the weighted arm and the opposite leg out level with the body, hold briefly, then return and repeat, swapping as set.

Focus: Keep the hips and shoulders square and the back flat, resisting the twist the added weight encourages. Move slowly, and keep the reach to where the neutral spine holds.

Wood chop – med ball / DB
How to
3 x 10 each sideLight

Start: Stand tall holding a med ball or dumbbell in both hands, feet hip-width, knees soft, core braced.

Movement: Sweep the weight down and across from above one shoulder to the opposite hip (or the reverse), rotating through the trunk, then return.

Focus: Turn through the trunk with the hips pivoting and knees soft, not twisting the lower back. Keep the ribs down, control the sweep, and don't fling the weight.

Dumbbell squat
How to
3 x 10Moderate

Start: Hold a dumbbell in each hand by your sides or racked at the shoulders, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, core braced.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down into a squat, keeping the chest up, then drive through the heels to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down throughout. Keep the chest up and the core braced, and go only as deep as your knees and hips stay comfortable.

Romanian deadlift
How to
3 x 10Moderate

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, holding the weight in front of your thighs with a soft bend in the knees. Set the shoulders back and brace the core.

Movement: Push the hips back and slide the weight down the front of your legs, keeping it close, until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings. Drive the hips forward to stand tall.

Focus: Keep the back flat throughout, never let it round. The movement is a hip hinge, not a squat, and the weight stays close to your legs. Only go as low as you can keep the back flat.

Reverse lunge to knee raise
How to
3 x 8 each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms ready to help drive.

Movement: Step one foot back into a reverse lunge, then drive back up and bring that knee up in front to hip height, balancing briefly, before stepping back again.

Focus: Keep the front knee over the ankle in the lunge and the hips level on the knee raise. Control the balance at the top, and drive through the standing heel rather than swinging up.

Bench press – narrow grip
How to
3 x 10Moderate

Start: Lie on the bench, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched back and down, hands about shoulder-width, unrack over the chest.

Movement: Lower the bar under control to the lower chest, elbows tucked close to the body, then press back up to straight arms.

Focus: Keep the elbows tucked close, which brings in the triceps and eases the shoulders, and the shoulder blades set. Keep the wrists stacked, lower under control, and don't let the elbows flare.

Band straight arm pull-down
How to
3 x 12Light

Start: Stand facing a high band, arms extended up and forward holding it, chest up, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: With straight arms, pull the band down towards the thighs in an arc, then return under control.

Focus: Keep the arms straight and drive the movement from the lats, feeling them work. Keep the ribs down and don't lean back, and control the return.

Balance – single leg knee drive
How to
3 x 8 each sideLight

Start: Stand on one leg, torso tall, the other knee ready to drive up, arms ready.

Movement: Drive the free knee up towards hip height, hold the balance briefly, then lower under control and repeat.

Focus: Keep the hips level and the standing knee soft, staying tall as the knee drives up. Fix the eyes on a point, control the drive and lower, and keep the core engaged.

Dead bug – with resistance
How to
3 x 10Light

Start: Lie on your back holding a band or light weight up over the chest, knees bent over the hips, back pressed into the floor.

Movement: Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly while holding the resistance steady above you, keeping the back flat, then swap.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor throughout, and the resistance held still and steady. Move slowly, and reduce the reach if the back begins to arch.

Leg press – bilateral
How to
3 x 10-1213.75kg

Start: Sit in the leg press, feet flat and hip to shoulder-width on the platform, hips and back settled into the pad, core braced.

Movement: Lower the platform under control until the knees reach a comfortable bend, then press back up through the whole foot without locking out hard.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking in line with the toes, never caving in, and the hips flat against the pad. Control the depth to what the knees allow, and don't slam the knees straight at the top.

Hip thrust – KB
How to
3 x 10Bodyweight

Start: Upper back against a bench, a kettlebell resting across the front of the hips, feet flat and hip-width, chin tucked, core braced.

Movement: Drive through the heels to push the hips up to a straight line, squeeze the glutes at the top, hold briefly, then lower with control.

Focus: Finish at a straight line with the glutes, not by arching the back. Keep the ribs down and the chin tucked, and keep the bell steady across the hips.

Band chest press – standing
How to
3 x 12Black band

Start: Anchor a band behind you, a handle in each hand at chest height, staggered stance, ribs down, core braced.

Movement: Press the hands forward until the arms are nearly straight, then return under control to the chest.

Focus: Keep the shoulder blades set and the ribs down, not arching to press. Keep the elbows a little below shoulder height, and control the band on the return.

Cross trainer
How to
5 mind

Start: Stand tall on the pedals, feet flat, hands on the handles, torso upright, core gently engaged.

Movement: Move the pedals and handles through a smooth striding rhythm for the set time or effort.

Focus: Stand tall with a relaxed upright posture, not slumping on the handles. Keep the stride smooth and even, and build the pace or resistance gradually.

Calf raises – single leg
How to
3 x 12 each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand on one foot, the ball of the foot on the floor or a step edge, holding a support for balance.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heel slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankle tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

Pad work
How to

Start: Stand in a balanced stance, hands up, knees soft, core engaged, facing the pads.

Movement: Strike the pads through the set combinations, returning the hands to guard each time, in rhythm.

Focus: Keep the movements controlled and the wrist firm on contact, not over-reaching or snapping the elbow. Stay balanced with soft knees, and keep the core engaged.

Bulgarian split squat
How to
3 x 8 each sideBodyweight

Start: Stand a stride in front of a bench, the top of your back foot resting on it, torso tall, arms for balance.

Movement: Lower straight down by bending the front knee until the thigh is towards parallel, then drive up through the front heel to the start.

Focus: Keep the front knee tracking over the foot, not caving in, and most of the weight through the front leg. Keep the torso tall, control the descent, and go only as deep as the front knee stays comfortable.

Romanian deadlift – KB
How to
3 x 1010kg

Start: Stand tall holding a kettlebell in front of the thighs with both hands, feet hip-width, soft knees, core braced.

Movement: Push the hips back and lower the bell down the front of the legs, keeping it close, until the hamstrings stretch, then drive the hips forward to stand.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the bell close throughout. Hinge at the hips, not the waist, and only lower as far as the flat back allows.

DB single-arm press
How to
3 x 8 each side5kg

Start: Stand or sit tall, a dumbbell at one shoulder, ribs down, core braced against the offset load.

Movement: Press the dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight, then lower back to the shoulder under control.

Focus: Keep the ribs down and resist leaning away from the weight, staying upright. Keep the shoulder down away from the ear, and press within a comfortable range.

Barbell hip row
How to
3 x 1010kg

Start: Hinge forward with a flat back holding a barbell at arms' length, chest up, core braced, hips back.

Movement: Pull the bar towards the hips, driving the elbows back, then lower under control while holding the hinge.

Focus: Keep the back flat and the hinge steady throughout, not rising or rounding as you row. Lead with the elbows, squeeze the shoulder blades, and keep the shoulders down.

Dead bug – arms only
How to
3 x 8 each sideBodyweight

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent up over the hips, arms reaching towards the ceiling, lower back gently pressed into the floor.

Movement: Lower one arm slowly overhead towards the floor, keeping the back flat, then return and swap arms.

Focus: Keep the lower back pressed to the floor throughout, this is the whole point. Move slowly, and if the back starts to arch, reduce the reach.

Calf raises – bilateral
How to
3 x 15Bodyweight

Start: Stand tall, feet hip-width, balls of the feet on the floor or the edge of a step, holding a support for balance.

Movement: Rise up onto the toes as high as you comfortably can, then lower the heels slowly under control.

Focus: Rise and lower slowly and evenly, not bouncing, through the full comfortable range. Keep the ankles tracking straight, not rolling out, and control the lower.

Box squat – goblet
How to
3 x 86kg

Start: Stand in front of a box at about parallel height holding a weight at the chest, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.

Movement: Sit the hips back and down to lightly touch the box, then drive up through the heels to stand tall, keeping the weight at the chest.

Focus: Keep the knees tracking over the toes and the heels down. Touch the box under control rather than dropping, and keep the chest up and the weight close throughout.

Glute bridges – weighted
How to
3 x 10Light

Start: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width, a weight or bar resting across the front of your hips, held gently in place.

Movement: Drive through the heels and push the hips up until the body is in a straight line, squeeze the glutes hard, hold, then lower with control.

Focus: Lift with the glutes, not by arching the back. Keep the ribs down and the core braced. Stop at a straight line rather than pushing into the lower back.

Lateral step-ups with DB
How to
3 x 8 each2 x 3kg

Start: Stand side-on to a step holding a dumbbell in each hand, near foot ready to step onto it.

Movement: Step the near foot up and drive through the heel to stand tall on the step, then lower back down with control, and repeat.

Focus: Keep the stepping knee over the foot, not caving in, and the hips level. Drive through the heel, control the lower, and keep the torso tall rather than leaning.

Single arm DB row – incline
How to
3 x 10 each7kg

Start: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in one hand hanging down, the other steadying you, back relaxed.

Movement: Pull the dumbbell towards the hip, driving the elbow back, then lower slowly under control.

Focus: Lead with the elbow and squeeze the shoulder blade, letting the bench keep the back supported and still. Keep the shoulder down, and control the lower without swinging.

Band crab walks
How to
3 x 10 eachLight

Start: Stand with a band around the legs, feet hip-width, knees softly bent, in a slight squat, torso tall.

Movement: Step diagonally forward and out one foot at a time, keeping tension on the band, then continue for the set steps.

Focus: Keep tension on the band and the knees pushing out, not caving in. Stay low and controlled, and feel the outer hips and glutes work.
